mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_source_version WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}
SELECT id FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code=#{unitCode}
SELECT id,unit_code unitCode FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code IN #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_claim_evidence(claim_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{claimCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_knowledge_evidence(knowledge_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{knowledgeCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,c.claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(c.subject,' ',c.predicate,' ',c.object_value) objectContent,c.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore, COALESCE(MAX(cf.conflictCount),0) conflictCount,COALESCE(MAX(cf.maxConflictScore),0) maxConflictScore,c.status FROM t_claim c LEFT JOIN t_claim_evidence ce ON ce.claim_code=c.claim_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ce.evidence_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT objectCode,COUNT(*) conflictCount,MAX(conflictScore) maxConflictScore FROM ( SELECT object_a_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' UNION ALL SELECT object_b_code objectCode,conflict_score conflictScore FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' ) conflict_rows GROUP BY objectCode ) cf ON cf.objectCode=c.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND c.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY c.id UNION ALL SELECT 'CARD' objectType,k.knowledge_code objectCode,CONCAT(k.title,' ',k.content) objectContent,k.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ke.evidence_id) evidenceCount,COUNT(DISTINCT e.source_id) sourceCount,COALESCE(AVG(e.authority_score),0) authorityScore,COALESCE(AVG(e.freshness_score),0) freshnessScore,0 conflictCount,0 maxConflictScore,k.status FROM t_knowledge_card k LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_evidence ke ON ke.knowledge_code=k.knowledge_code LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.id=ke.evidence_id WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND k.status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') GROUP BY k.id

SELECT e.evidence_code evidenceCode,e.quote_text quoteText,e.authority_score authorityScore,e.freshness_score freshnessScore,s.name sourceName,e.location_json locationJson FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_claim_evidence WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT e.evidence_code,e.quote_text,e.authority_score,e.freshness_score,s.name,e.location_json FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.id IN (SELECT evidence_id FROM t_knowledge_evidence WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode}) AND #{objectType}='CARD' LIMIT 8

SELECT object_a_code objectACode,object_b_code objectBCode,conflict_type conflictType,conflict_score conflictScore,status FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE status='OPEN' AND (object_a_code=#{objectCode} OR object_b_code=#{objectCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_adjudication_assessment(knowledge_base_id,object_type,object_code,policy_version,knowledge_confidence,risk_level,decision,requires_human_review,score_json,ai_judge_json,reason_text) VALUES(#{kb},#{objectType},#{objectCode},#{policyVersion},#{confidence},#{riskLevel},#{decision},#{requiresHuman},CAST(#{scoreJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{aiJson} AS JSON),#{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT id,object_type objectType,object_code objectCode,policy_version policyVersion,knowledge_confidence knowledgeConfidence,risk_level riskLevel,decision,requires_human_review requiresHumanReview,score_json scoreJson,ai_judge_json aiJudgeJson,reason_text reasonText,created_time createdTime FROM t_adjudication_assessment WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY updated_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY updated_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND subject IN #{subject} AND 1=0
SELECT * FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT d.id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus,d.chunk_count chunkCount,s.name sourceName,s.id sourceId,d.created_time createdTime FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY d.created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_card SET status=#{status} WHERE knowledge_code=#{code}
UPDATE t_claim SET status=#{status} WHERE claim_code=#{code}
mapper.select: SELECT id,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,object_a_code objectACode,object_b_code objectBCode,conflict_type conflictType,conflict_score conflictScore,status,created_time createdTime FROM t_knowledge_conflict WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (#{status} IS NULL OR status=#{status}) ORDER BY conflict_score DESC,created_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_knowledge_conflict SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT 'CARD' objectType,knowledge_code objectCode,title displayTitle,confidence,status FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') UNION ALL SELECT 'CLAIM' objectType,claim_code objectCode,CONCAT(subject,' ',predicate,' ',LEFT(object_value,120)) displayTitle,confidence,status FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('DRAFT','UNCERTAIN','CONFLICTED','PENDING_REVIEW') ORDER BY confidence ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_query_trace(query_id,knowledge_base_id,trace_id,original_query,rewritten_queries_json,router_decision_json,retrieval_json,fusion_json,rerank_json,selected_context_json,citations_json,model_name,latency_ms,token_usage_json,error_code,trace_json,answer) VALUES(#{queryId},#{knowledgeBaseId},#{traceId},#{originalQuery},CAST(#{rewrittenQueriesJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{routerDecisionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{retrievalJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{fusionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{rerankJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{selectedContextJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{citationsJson} AS JSON),#{modelName},#{latencyMs},CAST(#{tokenUsageJson} AS JSON),#{errorCode},CAST(#{traceJson} AS JSON),#{answer})
mapper.select: SELECT id,query_id queryId,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,trace_id traceId,original_query originalQuery,rewritten_queries_json rewrittenQueriesJson,router_decision_json routerDecisionJson,retrieval_json retrievalJson,fusion_json fusionJson,rerank_json rerankJson,selected_context_json selectedContextJson,citations_json citationsJson,model_name modelName,latency_ms latencyMs,token_usage_json tokenUsageJson,error_code errorCode,trace_json traceJson,answer,created_time createdTime FROM t_query_trace WHERE query_id=#{qid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_index_aggregate_version(aggregate_key,current_version) VALUES(#{aggregateKey},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_version=current_version+1
mapper.select: SELECT current_version FROM t_index_aggregate_version WHERE aggregate_key=#{aggregateKey}
SELECT * FROM t_index_outbox WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT * FROM t_index_outbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId}

SELECT o.* FROM t_index_outbox o WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND o.next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_index_outbox older WHERE older.aggregate_key=o.aggregate_key AND older.object_version<o.object_version AND older.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=attempt_count+1,locked_by=#{workerId},locked_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED',result_json=CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSON),last_error=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='DEAD',last_error=#{error},locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=CONCAT('Recovered stale lock; ',COALESCE(last_error,'')) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_at<#{threshold}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_index_delivery_attempt(event_id,attempt_no,status,duration_ms,response_json,error_text) VALUES(#{eventId},#{attemptNo},#{status},#{durationMs},CASE WHEN #{responseJson} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{responseJson} AS JSON) END,#{errorText})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) total, SUM(status='PENDING') pending, SUM(status='PROCESSING') processing, SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount, SUM(status='SUCCEEDED') succeeded, SUM(status='DEAD') dead, SUM(status='SKIPPED') skipped, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempt_count=0,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,processed_time=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY')
UPDATE t_index_outbox SET status='SKIPPED',locked_by=NULL,locked_at=NULL,processed_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status IN ('DEAD','RETRY','PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_claim WHERE claim_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})='CLAIM' UNION ALL SELECT knowledge_base_id FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_code=#{objectCode} AND UPPER(#{objectType})!='CLAIM' LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE')) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE'))
SELECT cu.id content_unit_id,cu.page_no,cu.heading_path,cu.content,cu.content_hash FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY cu.id

SELECT SUM(status='PENDING') pending,SUM(status='RETRY') retryCount,SUM(status='DEAD') dead, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING') THEN created_time END),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) oldestLagSeconds FROM t_index_outbox
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM t_index_delivery_attempt a JOIN t_index_outbox_archive o ON o.event_id=a.event_id WHERE o.processed_time<#{cutoff}

DELETE FROM t_index_outbox WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT o.id FROM t_index_outbox o JOIN t_index_outbox_archive a ON a.id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','SKIPPED') AND o.processed_time<#{cutoff} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}) x)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_index_schema_release WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}
SELECT * FROM t_index_schema_release WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET state=#{state},elasticsearch_count=#{elasticsearchCount},milvus_count=#{milvusCount},elasticsearch_target=#{elasticsearchTarget},milvus_target=#{milvusTarget},validation_json=CASE WHEN #{validationJson} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(#{validationJson} AS JSON) END,error_text=#{errorText} WHERE release_id=#{releaseId}

UPDATE t_index_schema_release SET state=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN state='ACTIVE' THEN 'RETIRED' ELSE state END, activated_time=CASE WHEN release_id=#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE activated_time END,retired_time=CASE WHEN state='ACTIVE' AND release_id<>#{releaseId} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE retired_time END WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (release_id=#{releaseId} OR state='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM t_index_outbox WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('CONTENT_UNIT:',cu.id) objectKey,CAST(cu.id AS CHAR) objectId,'CONTENT_UNIT' objectType, s.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,d.id documentId,cu.id contentUnitId, COALESCE(cu.heading_path,s.name) title,cu.content content,s.name sourceName,s.source_uri sourceUri, cu.page_no pageNo,cu.heading_path headingPath,NULL status,cu.content_hash contentHash,'' permissionTags FROM t_content_unit cu JOIN t_document d ON d.id=cu.document_id JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CARD:',knowledge_code),knowledge_code,'CARD',knowledge_base_id,NULL,NULL, title,COALESCE(content,summary),'知识卡片','',NULL,'',status, SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',knowledge_code,COALESCE(title,''),COALESCE(content,summary,''),COALESCE(status,''),COALESCE(version,0)),256),'' permissionTags FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CLAIM:',claim_code),claim_code,'CLAIM',knowledge_base_id,NULL,NULL, CONCAT('断言：',COALESCE(subject,'')),CONCAT_WS(' ',COALESCE(subject,''),COALESCE(predicate,''),COALESCE(object_value,'')), '断言','',NULL,'',status, SHA2(CONCAT_WS('|',claim_code,COALESCE(subject,''),COALESCE(predicate,''),COALESCE(object_value,''),COALESCE(status,'')),256),'' permissionTags FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND status IN ('APPROVED','EFFECTIVE') ) x ORDER BY objectKey LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
